method: Read-only catalog queries in the authenticated Supabase SQL Editor, plus real two-user REST/RPC acceptance
immutability_query: select count(*) from pg_class c where c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace and c.relkind='r' and not exists(select 1 from pg_trigger t where t.tgrelid=c.oid and t.tgfoid='private.reject_mutation()'::regprocedure and (t.tgtype::int & 24)=24)
limitations: Database owners and the service role remain trusted administrators
